Projects include a document-questioning agent that retrieves passages, scores candidates, and composes grounded answers, plus evaluation scripts that calculate recall and answer accuracy. The course presumes prompt and API skills and focuses on production-ready data handling and embedding strategies.
skills: sentence-transformers,Pinecone,Milvus,LangChain,RAG,embeddings,retrieval evaluation
tagline: Build retrieval-augmented agents using embeddings and vector databases for grounded answers.

title: Tooling, Orchestration, and Agent Reasoning
description: Create multi-step agents that select and orchestrate external tools safely and reliably. Design agents that call external tools, plan multi-step actions, and manage tool selection. You will implement tool interfaces (search, calculator, browser), use LangChain agents and custom action dispatchers, and add dialogue state tracking. The course covers caching, observability, and automated test suites for agent behaviors. Hands-on labs build an agent that plans tasks, invokes tools conditionally, and falls back to retrieval when needed. Prior courses' RAG and prompt skills are required; emphasis here is robust orchestration and safe tool use patterns.
skills: LangChain agents,tool integration,action dispatching,observability,caching,automated testing
tagline: Create multi-step agents that select and orchestrate external tools safely and reliably.

title: Productionizing AI Agents: Deployment, Safety, and Fine-Tuning
description: Deploy, fine-tune, and monitor production-grade AI agents with safety controls. Take an orchestrated agent to production: containerize with Docker, serve with FastAPI, and deploy using Kubernetes or a serverless platform. Learn model fine-tuning and parameter-efficient techniques (LoRA) on Llama-family or Hugging Face models, implement RLHF evaluation loops, and integrate monitoring (Prometheus, Sentry) and access controls. Final project deploys a secure agent that performs RAG, tool use, and online logging; includes rollout strategies, cost monitoring, and automated A/B evaluation of agent variants. Assumes prior orchestration, RAG, and prompt engineering skills.
skills: Docker,FastAPI,Kubernetes,LoRA,RLHF,Prometheus,Sentry
tagline: Deploy, fine-tune, and monitor production-grade AI agents with safety controls.

title: Foundations of ETL with Python and SQL
description: Implement and test repeatable ETL jobs using Python, pandas, and SQL. Learn to design and implement repeatable ETL jobs using Python, pandas and SQL. You will build a local data pipeline that ingests CSV and JSON files, performs data cleaning with pandas, loads transformed data into SQLite/Postgres, and containerize jobs with Docker. The course covers SQL JOINs, window functions, error handling, logging, and simple unit tests so you can run and validate pipelines locally before scaling them up.
skills: Python, pandas, PostgreSQL, SQL window functions, Docker, unit testing
tagline: Implement and test repeatable ETL jobs using Python, pandas, and SQL.

title: Batch Pipelines and Orchestration with Airflow and dbt
description: Schedule and manage repeatable batch ETL with Airflow and dbt. Build on ETL fundamentals to author scheduled batch pipelines using Apache Airflow and dbt. You will create DAGs that extract from Postgres and S3, enforce data transformations with dbt models and tests, implement task dependencies and retries, and deploy Airflow locally with Docker Compose. The course also covers connection management, XCom basics, templated SQL, and using dbt for versioned data models to produce curated tables ready for analytics.
skills: Apache Airflow, dbt, S3, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, SQL templating
tagline: Schedule and manage repeatable batch ETL with Airflow and dbt.

title: Real-time Data Streaming with Kafka and Spark
description: Create production-ready streaming pipelines using Kafka and Spark. Extend batch skills to real-time data by building streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming. You will set up Kafka topics and Kafka Connect to ingest events, implement Spark jobs that perform windowed aggregations and stateful operations, write output to Delta Lake or Parquet on S3, and handle schema evolution with Confluent Schema Registry. The course emphasizes exactly-once semantics, backpressure handling, and local testing of streaming jobs.
skills: Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka Connect, Delta Lake, Confluent Schema Registry, windowed aggregations
tagline: Create production-ready streaming pipelines using Kafka and Spark.

title: Production Data Pipelines: CI/CD, Monitoring, and Kubernetes
description: Deploy, monitor, and operate production data pipelines on Kubernetes. Combine prior batch and streaming work to deploy production-grade pipelines. You will containerize services, define infrastructure with Terraform, deploy Airflow and Spark jobs on Kubernetes, implement CI/CD for pipeline code using GitHub Actions, and add observability with Prometheus and Grafana. The course covers alerting, SLA monitoring, data contract enforcement, schema validation, and incident runbooks so you can operate and troubleshoot pipelines at scale in a reproducible manner.
skills: Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, GitHub Actions, CI/CD for data pipelines, SLA monitoring
tagline: Deploy, monitor, and operate production data pipelines on Kubernetes.

title: Financial Modeling Foundations with Excel
description: Build a clean, linked three-statement model in Excel. Learn to build a three-statement financial model in Excel that links income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. The course teaches structured workbook design, use of Excel functions (SUMIFS, INDEX-MATCH, IFERROR), basic data cleaning with Power Query, and creation of dynamic inputs and assumptions. By the end you will produce a modular model with working checks and formatted outputs suitable for further forecasting and valuation work.
skills: Microsoft Excel, Power Query, INDEX-MATCH, three-statement linking, model layout, workbook checks
tagline: Build a clean, linked three-statement model in Excel.

title: Forecasting and Corporate Financial Models
description: Create reconciled multi-year forecasts and scenario analyses. Using the three-statement model from the previous course, you will develop multi-year forecasts driven by driver-based forecasting techniques: revenue drivers, operating margins, working capital schedules and capex maintenance. The course covers historical trend analysis, seasonality adjustments, rolling forecasts, sensitivity tables, and scenario sheets. You will deliver a forecast pack with reconciled projections and a cash flow waterfall ready for valuation inputs.
skills: driver-based forecasting, working capital modelling, capex schedules, scenario analysis, sensitivity tables, Excel data validation
tagline: Create reconciled multi-year forecasts and scenario analyses.

title: Valuation Techniques: DCF and Comparable Analysis
description: Value a company using DCF and comparable multiples with sensitivity analysis. This course builds on your forecast model to perform valuation using discounted cash flow (DCF) and comparable company multiples. It demonstrates calculating free cash flow to firm, projecting terminal value (perpetuity and exit multiple methods), deriving WACC, and running sensitivity matrices and tornado charts. You will also collect comparable peer data, compute EV/EBITDA and P/E multiples, and reconcile implied equity values between DCF and comps.
skills: discounted cash flow (DCF), WACC calculation, terminal value methods, comparable company analysis, sensitivity matrices, EV/EBITDA multiples
tagline: Value a company using DCF and comparable multiples with sensitivity analysis.

title: Advanced Valuation and LBO Modeling in Excel + VBA
description: Build automated LBO and advanced valuation models with debt schedules. This advanced course assumes you can build forecasts and DCFs and extends them to leveraged buyout (LBO) modelling, debt schedules, interest curves, and investor return waterfalls. You will construct purchase price allocations, model debt tranches and covenants, perform IRR and cash return analyses, and automate scenario runs using VBA macros and data tables. The final deliverable is an integrated LBO model that outputs sponsor IRR, debt paydown profile, and sensitivity dashboards.
skills: LBO modelling, debt schedule construction, IRR and MOIC, purchase price allocation, VBA macro automation, covenant and sensitivity dashboards
tagline: Build automated LBO and advanced valuation models with debt schedules.

title: Practical Linux Security for Cyber Analysts
description: Harden a Linux server, configure logging, and secure SSH access. Build and harden a Linux server image, configure SSH and firewall rules, and implement host-based logging and audit trails. You will set up iptables/nftables, configure SSH key-based access and fail2ban, enable SELinux/AppArmor policies, and use auditd and syslog to capture suspicious activity. Course labs use Ubuntu/CentOS VMs and show how to automate baseline hardening with Ansible and manage updates with unattended-upgrades. After the course you can deploy a hardened Linux host and produce configuration checklists for operational use.
skills: iptables, SSH hardening, SELinux, auditd, Ansible, fail2ban
tagline: Harden a Linux server, configure logging, and secure SSH access.

title: Web Application Penetration Testing with OWASP Tools
description: Perform OWASP-guided web app pentests and produce actionable reports. Run end-to-end web application assessments using Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, and automated scanners plus manual verification. You will discover SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication flaws and insecure deserialization through hands-on labs against vulnerable apps, write exploit PoCs with SQLmap and custom scripts, and use Burp extensions for workflow automation. The course also teaches how to structure technical findings and produce remediation-focused penetration test reports for developers and security teams.
skills: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, SQLMap, XSS testing, CSRF testing, pentest reporting
tagline: Perform OWASP-guided web app pentests and produce actionable reports.

title: Cloud Security on AWS: Hardening and Detection
description: Configure AWS security controls and detect threats with CloudTrail and GuardDuty. Configure AWS security controls and build detection workflows using native services. Labs cover IAM least-privilege policies, VPC network controls, security group hardening, AWS Config rules, CloudTrail ingestion into S3, and setting up GuardDuty and Security Hub. You will also create automated remediation using AWS Lambda and explore logging and alerting patterns with CloudWatch Logs and Amazon Athena for threat hunting. By the end you can assess an AWS account for common misconfigurations and deploy continuous detection controls.
skills: AWS IAM, VPC security, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, AWS Config, CloudWatch Logs
tagline: Configure AWS security controls and detect threats with CloudTrail and GuardDuty.

title: Active Directory Offense and Defense
description: Exploit and defend Active Directory using real attack tools and mitigation patterns. Execute and mitigate real-world Active Directory attacks and hardening measures in lab environments. The course demonstrates enumeration and lateral movement with BloodHound, credential theft using Mimikatz and DCSync, Kerberos attacks with Rubeus, and privilege escalation paths. Defensive modules cover tiered administration, implementing LAPS, GPO hardening, advanced audit policy, and integrating detection with Microsoft Defender for Identity and event log analytics. Graduates can simulate AD attack chains and apply concrete mitigations to reduce exposure.
skills: BloodHound, Mimikatz, Kerberos attacks, LAPS, GPO hardening, AD auditing
tagline: Exploit and defend Active Directory using real attack tools and mitigation patterns.

title: Survival Spanish for Travelers
description: Communicate essential travel needs in Spanish using practiced phrases and pronunciation. Learn practical Spanish phrases, pronunciation, and cultural etiquette to navigate airports, hotels, restaurants, and emergency situations. You will build a phrasebook, use spaced-repetition flashcards with Anki, practice pronunciation with the IPA and minimal pairs, and complete role-play dialogues for check-in, ordering food, and asking for directions. Includes templates for polite requests, numbers and currency handling, and basic travel safety vocabulary so you can communicate essential needs during trips to Spanish-speaking countries.
skills: Anki, International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA), travel phrase construction, role-play dialogues, polite register
tagline: Communicate essential travel needs in Spanish using practiced phrases and pronunciation.

title: Intermediate Business English: Negotiation and Presentations
description: Lead negotiations and deliver business presentations with confident, professional English. Develop workplace-ready negotiation language and presentation skills for multinational teams. You will craft negotiation outlines, run simulated bargaining sessions, and design slide sequences with clear signposting language. The course teaches conditional language, hedging, persuasive framing, question strategies, and formal email templates using Grammarly and Google Slides. After completing case studies and peer feedback rounds, you can lead a negotiation script, deliver a 10-minute business presentation, and write follow-up emails to stakeholders.
skills: negotiation scripting, hedging and conditionals, business presentation design, email follow-ups, Grammarly, Google Slides
tagline: Lead negotiations and deliver business presentations with confident, professional English.

title: Advanced Academic Writing for Research Articles
description: Produce a submission-ready research article and craft targeted reviewer responses. Prepare, structure, and polish full research articles for submission to peer-reviewed journals. You will outline IMRAD sections, write clear literature reviews, construct methods and results with appropriate tense and modality, and craft discussion and conclusion paragraphs. The course covers reference management with Zotero, manuscript editing with Word Track Changes and Overleaf LaTeX templates, journal selection strategies, and responding to reviewers. By course end you will produce a submission-ready draft and a cover letter tailored to a chosen journal.
skills: IMRAD structure, Zotero reference management, LaTeX (Overleaf), manuscript editing with Track Changes, reviewer response drafting, journal selection
tagline: Produce a submission-ready research article and craft targeted reviewer responses.
